title: Brutal Ball prototype development
author: Historical-Day-3486
selftext:
10 days ago I had gotten graybox capsules to a three.js rendered field. Now... an actual character!

Hooked up Claude to Blender via MCP, then modelled the character\*, had Claude set up a rig with IK for feet. Then painted the weights, UV unwrapped the model, painted a quick texture in Procreate and had Claude run an export pipeline the get the models, textures and animations to my prototype.

A quick light for shadows inside the game with three.js and it's starting to look like a game!

Still so much work to do, but super excited to have a working pipeline from Blender to the game and easily committed to Render via Github so I can have my changes live within minutes!

Give it a go at [brutalball.net](https://brutalball.net)

\*Manually, tried very quickly having Claude create a character and... nope. Dusting off my 3d skills after 3 years of not doing any 3d 😄
